description: Toolbar shown for the data table.

className.description: Additional classes to pass to the wrapper `div` of the component.

children.description: The children to show in the toolbar.

alwaysShowFilterBar.description:
Whether to always render the filter bar, even when there are no active
filters or custom content. Useful to reserve its space and avoid layout
shifts when filters are added or removed.
